context_only: # tp v0.31.2 — De-magic the auditor routing
## 2. Auditor routing stops dispatching on role id
## 3. The default auditor prompts become language-neutral

tasks.title: Rename the shared selection to CodeFiles
tasks.acceptance: AuditFileSelection.Maintainability becomes CodeFiles, selectMaintainability becomes selectCodeFiles, MaintainabilityFileCap becomes CodeFileCap with value 10. Every committed reference in internal/engine/auditfiles_test.go is renamed with it. The quality gate passes.
source_sections: ### 2.5 The shared selection is named for what it is

tasks.title: Carry pre-cap totals on the selection
tasks.acceptance: AuditFileSelection gains int fields SpecCoverageTotal and CodeFilesTotal. CodeFilesTotal is the filtered-universe size after the drop rules while SpecCoverageTotal is the task-mapped set size in the normal branch and the filtered-universe size in the no-task fallback. A unit test pins both branches against a universe holding dropped files.
source_sections: ### 2.5 The shared selection is named for what it is

tasks.title: Rank priority paths ahead of the rest
tasks.acceptance: selectCodeFiles orders the filtered universe with path-keyword-matching files first then the rest, each group alphabetical, capped at CodeFileCap. A non-empty universe never yields an empty list. A test asserts a matching file that sorts last appears first and that a no-match universe yields the first CodeFileCap files alphabetically.
source_sections: ### 2.4 The security keyword list becomes a ranking signal, not a filter

tasks.title: Rename the keyword list to priorityPathSubstrings
tasks.acceptance: securitySubstrings becomes priorityPathSubstrings and containsSecuritySubstring becomes matchesPriorityPath. The five values lock, validate, auth, secret, perm are unchanged. A test asserts priorityPathSubstrings equals exactly those five values.
source_sections: ### 2.4 The security keyword list becomes a ranking signal, not a filter

tasks.title: Remove the per-role security file selection
tasks.acceptance: selectSecurity and AuditFileSelection.Security are removed so SelectAuditFiles returns the spec-coverage list plus the shared code-file list. TestFilterFiles_Security is deleted along with the security half of TestFilterFiles_Cap20. The quality gate passes with no unused symbol reported.
source_sections: ### 2.4 The security keyword list becomes a ranking signal, not a filter

tasks.title: Remove the HEAD content channel
tasks.acceptance: AuditFileInputs.HeadReader with its runAudit assignment, GitHeadReader, securityHeadLineCap and headLines are all removed, leaving AuditFileInputs holding Universe, DiffStats, Deleted and TaskFiles. A CLI-level test asserts a file whose path matches no keyword but whose content contains auth is ranked in alphabetical position rather than promoted. The quality gate passes with no unused symbol reported.
source_sections: ### 2.4 The security keyword list becomes a ranking signal, not a filter

tasks.title: Delete the two orphaned role constants
tasks.acceptance: The roleSecurity and roleMaintainability constants are deleted while roleSpecCoverage stays as the one id with a dedicated routing path. No source file references either deleted constant. The quality gate passes with no unused symbol reported.

A test covers both forms, the spec-coverage case, and a universe holding dropped files so the total is asserted post-drop.

tasks.title: Update the prompt body order test

tasks.title: Pin prompt equality across two invocations
tasks.acceptance: A test runs two audit invocations, each against a corpus holding exactly one role and no spec-coverage, with role ids of equal length differing only in their final character. tasks.title: Cover the empty code-file skip path
